question: How many repeat customers were there in January–June 2025 and in July–December 2025? Evaluate repeat status separately within each reporting period, then say which half had more.

action.query:
WITH period_orders AS (
  SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, 'January–June 2025' AS REPORTING_PERIOD
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER
  WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2025-07-01'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, 'July–December 2025' AS REPORTING_PERIOD
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER
  WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-07-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
), repeat_customers AS (
  SELECT REPORTING_PERIOD, CUSTOMER_ID
  FROM period_orders
  WHERE CUSTOMER_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY REPORTING_PERIOD, CUSTOMER_ID
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT REPORTING_PERIOD, COUNT(*) AS REPEAT_CUSTOMER_COUNT
FROM repeat_customers
GROUP BY REPORTING_PERIOD
ORDER BY REPORTING_PERIOD

action.answer: A repeat customer is a customer with more than one recorded order within the reporting period. January–June 2025: 95,048 repeat customers. July–December 2025: 96,514 repeat customers. July–December had 1,466 more repeat customers.
